name: A break-in
prompt: Your door is splintered at the lock. Drawers are open, and what cash you kept in the flat is gone.

choices.text: Fix the lock and move on

outcome.told: You wedge a chair against the door until the new lock is in.
outcome.line: {you} came home to a break-in and fixed the lock.

outcome.told: An officer takes a statement and gives you a case number.
outcome.line: {you} reported a break-in to the police.

failure.told: The officer takes the statement. Nobody calls back.
failure.line: {you} reported a break-in that was never solved.
